title: amblyopogon xanthocephalus
intro: Amblyopogon xanthocephalus, commonly known as Golden Hair Grass, is a type of flowering plant in the family Poaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving immune function, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Golden Hair Grass include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Amblyopogon xanthocephalus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
